baselines.no_feedback: same learner with all feedback replaced by zero
baselines.reward_shuffled: same learner with online random permutation draws from observed rewards

gates.question: Does a goal cue remain useful across two feedback-driven decisions?
Do task instances expose at least two practically successful local means?
Does true scalar feedback beat both shuffled and absent feedback?
Does feedback improve evaluator-only recovery of the deleted identities?
Does a frozen learner retain practical gain on unseen N and damage masks?
Does an authorized goal switch work while an unauthorized distractor is ignored?

information_boundary.structural_privilege: Exact local labels, N, and the complete current action menu are exposed. This is not leak-tight agency evidence.
